newsitem.title: USA: Vail sets $2.5 mln reorganization reserve.
newsitem.headline: Vail sets $2.5 mln reorganization reserve.

text.p: Vail Resorts Inc said it will establish a third quarter reserve of $2.2 million to cover reorganization expenses.
Vail said the move came after it completed a review and reorganization of newly acquired and merged operations.
It said the reserve will cover severance payments for administrative staff reductions as well as other expenses from consolidation.
It said the reorganization will result in a reduction of more than $2.5 million in operating expenses. It said the savings will be realized in the next fiscal year.
The company earlier reported second quarter pro forma earnings of $1.42 per share versus $1.31. The quarter ended March 31.
